params.body:
## What

On Beheer > Dealers > Dealer aanpassen the tab **Portals** is back, in third place after Bedrijf and Werknemers, for administrators only (`dealer.edit`; a dealer editing his own profile through `ownuser.edit` does not get it, as before).

It lists every portal from the `portals` table with a switch. On writes the link row in `portaalsites` (`dealer.create.portal`), off deletes it (`dealer.destroy.portal`). Both endpoints answer with the re-rendered list, so each switch always carries the url for its next state. A notify confirms each change; the dealer's own Opslaan is not involved (the inputs are named `exclude[...]`, which `DealerController::update` already ignores).

## Why

Reported by Ilse on 2026-09-16. In the old app the tab was labelled "Portals" but keyed `dealer.modix`, and it carried both the Modix FTP fields and the dealer portals list. Commit 7aa1ce5f (2026-07-28, "Modix volledig verwijderd (verouderd), portals + import behouden") removed the whole tab; the partial, the routes and the controller methods stayed, unreachable. Since the cutover no dealer could get a portal switched on or off. Existing links kept working because the `portaalsites` rows were untouched. (The table named in the report, `dealer_portals`, is an empty table without a key; the real link is `portaalsites`.)

## Behaviour differences, declared

- The old list was a select plus a plus button and a trash per row, and allowed linking the same portal twice. The switch cannot, and `addPortal` now refuses a second row for the same dealer and portal (and reads only `portals_id` from the request).
- An empty choice is still refused (R P2-1.4).

## Rules and findings

- R P2-1.4 rewritten to describe the tab, its rights and the one-row-per-portal rule; stand `klant`.
- Finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-16-portals-tab-verdwenen.md`, status opgelost.
- New translation keys in `dealer.php` for nl/fr/en/de (`portals`, `portals_uitleg`, `portals_geen`, `portal_gekoppeld`, `portal_ontkoppeld`, `portal_fout`).

## Tests

`DealerPortalsTabTest` (6 tests, `@rule P2-1.4`): admin sees the tab with every portal and the linked one switched on; switching on writes one row and a repeat does not duplicate; switching off deletes the row; an empty choice is refused; a user without dealer rights is redirected and nothing is written; the own-profile page has no tab.

Run locally: `DealerPortalsTabTest`, `SmokeTest` (dealer), `CompiledViewsTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `DealerAuthorizationTest`: OK (48 tests, the known es-parity incomplete).

Verified in the browser at 1440 and 390 px: tab visible, toggling Cartel on and 2dehands off re-rendered the list, showed both notifies and left exactly those rows in `portaalsites`.
params.title: Dealer edit: the Portals tab is back
